scenes.name: problem
scenes.caption: Capability Forge turns verified observations into a reusable local service. This entire walkthrough is SIMULATED: no physical TV or beacon is being scanned.

scenes.name: path
scenes.caption: The workspace has no direct observation in this fixture. An approved TV relay supplies signal observations. A relay path never implies control of the beacon.

scenes.name: unavailable
scenes.caption: Honest model state: the local Glimmer route is unavailable here. Separate recorded startup attempts failed. No model success is simulated and no cloud fallback occurs.

scenes.name: explicit-rules
scenes.caption: We explicitly choose deterministic rules. The validated plan reads existing relay observations, then proposes publication. It cannot grant consent or execute a hardware action.

scenes.name: publish
scenes.caption: After refreshing only the synthetic fixture, the owner approves publication. A real local HTTP service is created from a fixed read-only primitive, with current permission and freshness checks.

scenes.name: read
scenes.caption: The local API returns actual fixture data: signal strength, relay provenance, observation time and evidence references. This is not a temperature or battery measurement.

scenes.name: contract
scenes.caption: The compiler emits OpenAPI 3.1, standalone JSON Schemas and a fixed Python client. Model-generated code is never executed. A separate client test verified this route and its revocation.

scenes.name: revocation
scenes.caption: Stop and remove: the service is REVOKED. Its observation route returns 404. No device setting was changed, so physical Undo is neither needed nor claimed.

scenes.name: results
scenes.caption: Measured results remain visible: rules 64/64 accepted plans; Llama 0/64; Glimmer unavailable. No intelligence advantage is claimed. Provider credits used for these local tests: $0.

scenes.name: close
scenes.caption: OpenBridge · github.com/toskaman/openbridge · feat/capability-forge. Tested contracts and real loopback API; simulated observations. Physical relay integration remains gated on runtime evidence and timestamps.

scope: simulated fallback demonstration; actual local HTTP service; rules route explicitly selected; no live hardware or successful Glimmer plan claimed
